# Camp Resource: Firewood Pile

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Feb 19, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Aug 12, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bd1cbd397b574998b9ee4db68f72a3f3~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

When you need to throw another log on the fire just reach for this handy Firewood Pile!

- Collects Wood over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Firewood Pile__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3b7ea4f1c0e54c3698fbcdf4f4d33ee5~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Wood scraps

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

40 wood scraps

**Obtainable via**

Season 12 Scoreboard - Rip Daring and the Cryptid Hunt - Free

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Cautious - 1250 Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

#### **Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
